settings.blockDesc: Engineered With Evidence-Backed Ergonomics For Peak Consistency.

settings.item_block_desc: The Athena Pro Team Liquid Edition unites advanced ergonomics with competition-tested support. Its adjustable lumbar system and reinforced seat base are built for long hours of focused play without compromising stability — made for players who expect precision, consistency, and the professional standards set by Team Liquid.

settings.itemTitle: CRAFTED WITH TEAM LIQUID'S SIGNATURE DETAIL
settings.itemDesc: A sculpted Team Liquid emblem sits at the top of the Athena Pro, stitched with 3D embroidery that blends depth, precision, and an unmistakably premium feel. Available in two color variants, designed to suit a variety of personal styles and setups.

A prominent Team Liquid emblem defines the backrest, modeled after the team’s timeless horse-head insignia that represents strength and resilience. Rendered in sculpted 3D embroidery on our signature Nexgen Eco Leatherette, it delivers layered depth and a refined, modern aesthetic—honoring the spirit that defines Team Liquid.

settings.prod_desc: Shaped to keep you grounded, aligned, and comfortable.
settings.prod_feature-0-desc: Why settle for stiff, uncomfortable foam when our upgraded ultra-soft memory foam offers superior softness and lasting resilience? It cradles you in cloud-like comfort while providing the perfect support, designed to keep you comfortable, focused, and supported for years to come.
settings.prod_feature-1-desc: The lumbar support is the heart of any great gaming chair, and ours is exceptional. With adjustable height and depth, it ensures a perfect fit for your spine, delivering ultimate comfort and support. The backrest is enhanced with memory foam, offering even more softness and comfort while providing superior support for long gaming sessions.
settings.prod_feature-2-desc: Built for gaming, lounging, napping, and more. Adjust to any position effortlessly with a simple lever pull and push.
settings.prod_feature-3-sub-title: PRECISE ARM SUPPORT RELIEVE SHOULDER & ARM STRESS
settings.prod_feature-3-desc: Our 4-Way Dynamic Armrests are engineered to support your natural posture, moving seamlessly in every direction to reduce stress on your muscles and joints. These armrests provide the perfect alignment to keep you supported and comfortable.

settings.sectionDesc: Blacklyte is the official chair of premier esports tournaments and the go-to seat for top players. Ergonomically crafted and tested in both science and competition, it delivers stage-ready comfort and support.
